text:
Can you beat the plumber who's ranked first in Midland for 15 years?

Yes. Pick a service his website barely mentions. Say, hot water systems.

Write one clear page on hot water in Midland.

Win that search first. Then do the next service.

Picture a sparky in Osborne Park. His biggest competitor has 312 reviews and shows closed on weekends.

Our bloke does Saturday callouts and lists those hours on Google.

Being open when someone searches is a top-five map ranking factor.

Saturday night, our bloke gets the call.

47 experts scored 187 Google Maps ranking factors for 2026.

Number one: the main category on your Google Business Profile.

Joondalup plumber with "Gas installation service" listed first? His customers type "plumber Joondalup".

Make your main category the word customers search.
